headline: One-week social media abstinence has direct evidence, but the balance is mixed: some RCT/pre-post sources show improved well-being or distress, while other direct and review evidence reports null or negative/burden signals.
implication: Use to keep the 7-day Social Media Fast evidence balanced rather than universally positive.
